Name: Sober
Notes: ROUND AN - THE DRUNK METER (Anthony, 8 Oct: in the pub, when a player drinks, their drunk meter reaches certain levels that give them special treatment). FROM is the % on the meter where this level starts; the rows can be in any order and the highest one he has reached is his level. Sober: nothing poured takes hold - no elemental brew, no inspirational brew.

Name: Tipsy
Notes: BREWS: from here the inspirational brews (any brew that gives an ability) take hold. Below this they can still be drunk (Anthony, 8 Oct: an elemental brew can always be drunk) and fill the meter, but they do nothing in the match, and a turning beer does not count towards turning him. DRAFT number - yours to change.

Name: Elemental
Notes: TURNS (Anthony, 9 Oct): "60% needed and then drink any of the elemental beers to transform them from normal to an elemental one." Any brew with a Becomes (Fire Brew, Water Brew, the turning beers) turns a plain player ONLY if he was at this level BEFORE he drank it - class, element and abilities all at once. Too sober and it only fills his meter. To switch element, give him a Glass of Water (Brews.csv water_glass) until he is below this level: that turns him back to plain. Move the word turns to another level to change the number. DRAFT.
